title: Cast type
description: A solid typographic object turns to show its extruded edges.
useCase: Give a wordmark dimensional weight without downloading a model or font.
reducedMotion: Live reduced-motion preferences remove interpolation and decorative playback. All content and native controls remain available. Keyboard changes settle immediately.
limitations: Original demonstration content; adapt labels and state to the host product.
look: Heavy pale-pink serif letters with deep, darker extruded sides float over a saturated coral-red radial gradient, with a single slider below.
motion: Dragging the slider turns the wordmark around its vertical axis between -48° and 48° with a 0.2 s ease-out, revealing 18 stacked layers as extruded edges.
adapt: Depth is 18 stacked `b` copies inside `cast`, each offset by `translateZ` and darkened via `hsl`; the turn is `rotateY` on `object` with a 0.2 s ease-out transition driven by `angle`. Replace the `OH` wordmark, font and colours; keep the `data-still` reduced-motion switch.
